name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor for repairs instead of an independent handyman?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of hiring a general contractor for repairs instead of an independent handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with a full-scope remodeling contractor like HH Remodeling gives you access to specialized finish carpentry, drywall, and tile skills that standard handymen may lack. If an uncovered issue turns out to be more severe—such as finding hidden framing rot behind damaged drywall or needing sub-trade coordination for plumbing fixtures—Abraham Becerra can manage the broader scope seamlessly. A general handyman may handle basic tasks but often lacks the licensing, crew capacity, or finish expertise for complex surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor provides superior finish craftsmanship and can seamlessly handle larger structural or sub-trade issues if a minor repair exposes deeper hidden damage.
